description.narrative: By 2027, government at the national, State, and high-priority districts levels have enhanced capacity for policy, planning, budgetary, implementation (including community engagement), and MERL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Research, and Learning) actions to scale up essential RMNCH+A interventions, with focus on vulnerable groups, especially the girl child, in selected states. This work breakdown structure activity contributed to sublevel results - Immunization services as part of primary health care,Life saving interventions,Immunization and wild polio eradication,Cross sectoral - Social and behaviour change

title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced equitable immunization delivery by supporting Government's Zero-Dose Implementation Plan across 143 high-priority districts in 11 states. Through 19 CSO partnerships, UNICEF supported identification of 35,574 zero-dose children, 87,395 hesitant/resistant children, 632 missed communities, 50,560 local influencers strengthening real-time feedback and accelerating targeted outreach to the most underserved populations.
